claims.quote: Betta hipposideros is a paternal mouthbrooding labyrinth fish from peat swamps in western Peninsular Malaysia and eastern Sumatra, Indonesia.
Betta hipposideros is a paternal mouthbrooding labyrinth fish from peat swamps in western Peninsular Malaysia and eastern Sumatra, Indonesia.

regions.name: Peninsular Malaysia
regions.quote: Described from the north Selangor peat swamp forest in Selangor state, western Peninsular Malaysia, and subsequently recorded from localities in Perak state to the north.

regions.name: Sumatra
regions.quote: Its range also extends into Riau province, eastern Sumatra, and the Riau Archipelago, Riau Islands province, Indonesia.
